import copy,json,sys,unittest
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'tools/behavior-tests')
import test_terraform_height_browser_audit as t
D=Path('/tmp/terraform-land-height-v6-second')
records=t.audit.parse_records((D/'application.log').read_bytes()); report=json.loads((D/'report.json').read_bytes())
class ChangedRetainedCases(unittest.TestCase):
 def test_nonpayer_native_energy_bool_rejected(self):
  r,q=copy.deepcopy((records,report))
  packets=[v for k,v,_ in r if k=='TH_NATIVE']
  for packet in packets:
   state=packet['world']; player=next(p for p in state['players'] if p['raw_id']==1)
   state['terrain_trace']['player_details'][player['id']]['energy']['credits']=True
  for item,packet in zip(q['native_snapshots'],packets):item['observation']=t.audit.node_projection(packet)
  with self.assertRaisesRegex(AssertionError,'Native player energy'):t.audit.audit_records(r,q)
 def test_transient_hidden_row_before_mouseup_rejected(self):
  x=t.ProtocolPointerRouteTests();x.original_route=(records,report);x.setUp()
  x.insert_target_event(2,'up','node.hide',{})
  x.insert_target_event(2,'end','node.show',{})
  with self.assertRaisesRegex(AssertionError,'became hidden'):t.audit.validate_pointer_route(x.records,x.report)
r=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromTestCase(ChangedRetainedCases));assert not r.skipped
raise SystemExit(not r.wasSuccessful())
